description: Generic autocomplete popup (role=listbox) shown when active, displaying error, loading, or empty messages or a list of items with icon/glyph, label, description, and optional grouping or custom template, with keyboard navigation.

parameters.name: IsVisible
parameters.description: Whether the autocomplete menu is visible.

parameters.name: ErrorMessage
parameters.description: Whether the menu is loading provider results.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Whether the autocomplete menu is visible.

parameters.name: ItemTemplate
parameters.description: Text displayed when no results match.

parameters.name: OnHighlightedIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised when an item is selected.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: Items displayed in the autocomplete menu.

parameters.name: Trigger
parameters.description: Current query text without the trigger marker.
